# FaceBlur Studio

**Local video face blurring**

Preview, track faces and choose which faces to blur. Your videos stay on your computer.

## Download and try

- [Windows 10/11 x64 — version 1.1.27 (EXE, 126 MiB)](https://github.com/sirdimitry/FaceBlur-Studio/releases/download/v1.1.27/FaceBlur-Studio-1.1.27-Windows-Setup.exe)
- [Apple Silicon Mac — version 1.1.28 (DMG, 293 MiB)](https://github.com/sirdimitry/FaceBlur-Studio/releases/download/v1.1.28/FaceBlur_Studio_v1.1.28_Apple_Silicon.dmg)

Download FaceBlur Studio and try it on a video. We would love to hear how it works for you: share your feedback in [Issues](https://github.com/sirdimitry/FaceBlur-Studio/issues). If you find it useful, consider a [Star](https://github.com/sirdimitry/FaceBlur-Studio), [Fork](https://github.com/sirdimitry/FaceBlur-Studio/fork) or [Watch](https://github.com/sirdimitry/FaceBlur-Studio) to follow updates. Thank you for helping the project improve.

> The macOS DMG includes all seven interface languages, system-language detection and the Arabic right-to-left workspace. The Windows installer remains version 1.1.27; the new interface features are available in the updated source and will be included in a future Windows installer.

## Screenshot

![FaceBlur Studio 1.1.23 showing face analysis and video preview](assets/faceblur-studio-1.1.23.png)

## Features

- Automatic face detection and tracking with YOLOv8-face.
- Apple Metal acceleration on macOS or DirectML on Windows, with CPU fallback.
- Choose which faces to blur; adjust mask size, shape, blur strength and edge feathering.
- Fast preview and accurate face selection in scaled video.
- Save and reopen `.fbp` projects with analysis results and face selections.
- Export MP4 with the original audio track when present.
- Read video frames as needed instead of keeping the whole decoded video in RAM.
- Process video locally without uploading it to a cloud service.
- Seven interface languages, automatic system-language detection and an Arabic right-to-left workspace in the updated source.

Automatic detection can miss faces. Review the entire exported video before sharing it.

## Installation

**Windows 10/11 x64:** run the installer and follow the English or Russian setup wizard. The default location is `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\FaceBlur Studio`; installation is per user and does not require administrator rights. Python, FFmpeg, the model and inference libraries are bundled. Uninstall through Windows Settings; user projects and settings are preserved.

The Windows installer is unsigned. Installation, reinstallation, packaged startup and uninstallation were verified on the development Windows 11 machine; a separate clean Windows/VM has not yet been tested. See [installer details](docs/WINDOWS_INSTALLER.md) and [Windows verification results](docs/WINDOWS_VALIDATION.md).

Windows SHA-256: `01f751ca1d29a5be5cfb9a4feae240af1d4b2747722c078f27ba1f903039365d`

**Apple Silicon Mac:** open the DMG and drag **FaceBlur Studio** to **Applications**. Python, FFmpeg and the face detection model are bundled and need no separate installation.

This preliminary DMG uses a local ad hoc signature and is **not notarized** by Apple. macOS may block its first launch. If you trust the download, follow [Apple's Open Anyway instructions](https://support.apple.com/en-au/102445) in System Settings → Privacy & Security. A separate clean Mac has not been tested. This image targets Apple Silicon; it does not support Intel Macs or Windows.

macOS SHA-256: `9ba0cc0fd5c9dfba8a58c90ba0f4e16e2f4460efcc725131505016deb547ed1d`

### Run from source

Python 3.12 and FFmpeg are required. The macOS model `yolov8s-face.pt` and Windows model `yolov8s-face.onnx` are included. On macOS, install FFmpeg with `brew install ffmpeg`, then run:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/sirdimitry/FaceBlur-Studio.git
cd FaceBlur-Studio
python3 -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python main.py
```

On Windows, use PowerShell, Python 3.12 and FFmpeg on PATH. Activate with `.\venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1` and install `requirements-windows.txt` instead of `requirements.txt`. See the [Windows port guide](docs/WINDOWS_HANDOFF.md) and [installer build instructions](docs/WINDOWS_INSTALLER.md). The [DMG build script](scripts/build_macos_dmg.sh) requires `create-dmg`.

## Getting started

1. Open a video and click **Find faces**.
2. Select faces in the gallery, adjust the mask and review the preview.
3. Save an `.fbp` project to continue later, or export an MP4.

## Interface languages

On first launch, the updated app uses your system's preferred supported UI language, falling back to English. In **Settings → Interface language**, choose **Automatic — system language** or a specific language. Your choice is saved and applies immediately without closing the project. Supported languages: English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Arabic, Serbian (Cyrillic), Greek and Spanish.

Arabic uses right-to-left text and a mirrored inspector/action layout. Video pixels, face coordinates, filenames, numbers and playback timelines keep their original meaning and direction.

## Diagnostics

Log locations:

- Source run: `debug_app.log`
- Installed macOS app: `~/Library/Logs/FaceBlurStudio/debug_app.log`
- Installed Windows app: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\FaceBlurStudio\Logs\debug_app.log`

Open the log folder from **About → Open log folder**. Logs may contain local paths; review them before sharing.

## Support and contributing

Report bugs, share feedback or suggest improvements in [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/sirdimitry/FaceBlur-Studio/issues). Include the app version, operating system, steps to reproduce and expected result. Attach a reviewed log if useful, but keep private videos out of public reports. Translation corrections are welcome.

Maintained by [@sirdimitry](https://github.com/sirdimitry). To contribute, open an issue describing the change, then submit a pull request with a brief explanation and validation results. Update every language version when changing the README; see [localization workflow](docs/LOCALIZATION.md).
